name: base-quality-recalibration
description: Recalibrate base quality scores to correct systematic errors in the sequencer's quality estimates. GATK BaseRecalibrator models quality score errors as a function of reported quality, read group, sequencing cycle, and dinucleotide context using a set of known variant sites (dbSNP, Mills indels, 1000 Genomes known indels) to distinguish true variants from errors. ApplyBQSR writes recalibrated scores. Skip for PCR-free WGS if downstream caller handles raw quality appropriately.
